project.name: 灵光周报
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Cyberpunk future-street style for teen AI news site — dark navy base, neon cyan primary (#00f0ff), magenta accent (#ff3366), Orbitron display font, scanline/grid textures, glowing borders, street-style energy
project.designRead: Teen AI news portal / 10-18 youth / cyberpunk street energy / medium density / avoid pastel or minimal corporate

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: neon cyan #00f0ff for CTAs, active states, glows and highlights
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single primary neon cyan; state colors (success=green, warning=amber, error=magenta, info=purple) for tags only

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius: sm=2px, md=6px, lg=12px, xl=16px; sharp cyberpunk edges
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Orbitron for display/headings, Rajdhani + Noto Sans SC for body, JetBrains Mono for data/tags
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: compact urban rhythm; base 1rem; generous whitespace between sections
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: neon-border cards, glow effects, cyber-grid backgrounds, scanline overlays
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: dark layered surfaces with neon glow shadows; border > shadow for static cards
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: cyberpunk photography, holographic UI screenshots, neon-lit scenes
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: energetic, bold hover states with glow intensification

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: fixed top nav with logo left, channel links center, search right; neon underline on active item; dark glassmorphism background
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: single primary neon cyan #00f0ff; no secondary/accent brand hue
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Orbitron display, Rajdhani body, Noto Sans SC fallback; 5xl-3xl-2xl-xl-lg-base scale
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: dark bg #0a0a1a, elevated #12122a, surface #1a1a3e; border-based cards with subtle glow
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: filled neon cyan bg, dark text, glow shadow on hover, rounded-md

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Cyberpunk dark theme with neon cyan primary, Orbitron display, sharp edges, glowing borders
